results.label: Board / list, page 1, sorted by fractional rank (the benchmark)
results.text:
select t.id, t.title, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.type, t.rank,
                  t.assignee_id, t.ticket_number, t.points, t.due_date, t.created_at
           from build.tickets t
           where t.org_id = $1 and t.project_id = $2 and t.deleted_at is null
           order by t.rank asc, t.created_at desc, t.id asc
           limit 50 offset 0
nodes: Index Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_project_rank_sort

results.label: Same list at offset 3000 (offset pagination cost)

results.label: The COUNT(*) fired alongside every list request
results.text: select count(*) from build.tickets t where t.org_id = $1 and t.project_id = $2 and t.deleted_at is null
nodes: Index Only Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_project_number

results.label: Search: leading-wildcard ILIKE on title (seq-scan under RLS — use app.search_ticket_ids SDF instead)
results.text:
select t.id, t.title from build.tickets t
           where t.org_id = $1 and t.project_id = $2 and t.deleted_at is null and t.title ILIKE '%ticket 1234%'
           order by t.rank asc limit 50
nodes: Index Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_project_status

results.label: My Work: assigned tickets across the whole org
results.text:
select t.id, t.title, t.status, t.priority, t.due_date, t.project_id
           from build.tickets t
           where t.org_id = $1 and t.assignee_id = $3 and t.deleted_at is null and t.status <> 'DONE'
           order by t.due_date asc nulls last limit 50
nodes: Index Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_assignee_due_open

results.label: Per-column badge counts for the board
results.text:
select t.status, count(*) from build.tickets t
           where t.org_id = $1 and t.project_id = $2 group by t.status
nodes: Index Only Scan on tickets using idx_tickets_org_project_status

results.label: Dependency edges for a ticket (blocks / blocked_by)
results.text:
select r.id, r.relation_type, r.work_item_id, r.related_work_item_id
           from build.work_item_relations r
           where r.org_id = $1 and (r.work_item_id = $4 or r.related_work_item_id = $4)

results.label: Portfolio dashboard: per-project open/done rollup from daily snapshots
results.text:
select s.project_id::int,
                  coalesce(sum(case when s.state_group in ('backlog','unstarted','started') then s.count else 0 end),0)::int open_count,
                  coalesce(sum(case when s.state_group = 'completed' then s.count else 0 end),0)::int done_count
           from build.project_daily_snapshots s
           where s.org_id = $1
             and s.snapshot_date = (
               select max(s2.snapshot_date) from build.project_daily_snapshots s2 where s2.project_id = s.project_id
             )
           group by s.project_id
           order by open_count desc limit 50
nodes: Index Scan on project_daily_snapshots using idx_project_daily_snapshots_org_project

Sort Key: ((COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN (s.state_group = ANY ('{backlog,unstarted,started}'::text[])) THEN s.count ELSE 0 END), '0'::bigint))::integer) DESC
